_comment: Copy to rules.json and edit. Rules start agent runs on their own, so they are bounded by cooldown_minutes and by MAX_AUTO_RUNS_PER_DAY. Placeholders available in goal: {title} {url} {source} {symbol} {name} {price} {change_percent}.

rules.name: Sharp index move
rules.goal: {name} moved {change_percent}% today, to {price}. Find out what drove the move, using recent market headlines and the web, and give me three sentences.

rules.name: Central bank news
rules.goal: This headline just came in: "{title}" ({url}). Summarise what was actually said and what it means for rates and equities. Be brief.
